description: Encyclopedic grounding in one call: Wikipedia search plus the full summary of the best match — extract, short description, canonical URL, thumbnail — in any of 300+ language editions. Official Wikimedia REST APIs, CC BY-SA attribution included. The cheapest way for an agent to ground an entity before reasoning about it. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

query.description: Entity or topic to look up (2-300 chars)
